task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, take a trip south. With that done, try to venture west. That done, attempt to venture north. And then, take a trip west. After that, try to go south. After that, attempt to move west. If you can get around to doing that, make an effort to go north. Then, try to head north. Then, make an effort to go east. After that, go to the north. With that accomplished, try to take a trip north. And then, retrieve the apple from the floor of the austere cubicle. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You've just sauntered into a closet.



There is an unguarded exit to the east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

thought: I will follow the instructions step-by-step, starting by going south.
feedback:

You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an unblocked exit to the west.
